system.description:
When you deal damage to a creature,
mark a Stress to lock their threat
profile into your Redline system.
Until this feedback ends, your combat
implants, adrenal processors, pain
editor, and aggression software remain
fixated on the target. You always know
the direction of it relative to you.
Additionally, each time that creature
deals damage to you or an ally within
Very Close range of you, your Redline
system fires a hostile feedback spike
back through the link, forcing them to
mark a Stress.
This feedback ends when you use this
protocol again.
